note: Legacy-media scale and the money-follows-attention story. FICCI-EY M&E (industry revenue by segment, INR billion, actuals 2022-2025; verified from the report PDF) and PRGI 'Press in India 2023-24' (registered print titles + self-declared claimed circulation by language; verified from the report PDF).

ficci_ey.vintage: FICCI-EY 'Stories, scale and impact' (latest edition; actuals 2022-2025, INR billion). Digital overtook television in 2024.

digital_advertising_2025.note: Digital advertising rose 26% to INR947 billion in 2025, about 63% of all advertising spend.

prgi.vintage: Press Registrar General of India, 'Press in India 2023-24' (as on 31 March 2024).
prgi.caveat: Circulation is SELF-DECLARED by publishers and explicitly NOT verified by PRGI. 'Registered' is a cumulative stock; of 1,51,474 registered periodicals only 36,358 (~24%) actually filed an annual statement, on which the circulation analysis rests. Treat circulation as indicative and likely inflated.

claimed_circulation_by_language_million.label: Claimed circulation by language, 2023-24 (self-declared, copies per publishing day)
